address: 823 Whitehead St., Key West, FL, 33040, USA
bio: Situated in Old Town Key West and offering an all-day menu, this large, colorful bungalow-style space may just have a few roaming roosters outside. It's decidedly laidback but don't let that fool you — the food is hearty and well prepared no matter the time of day. In the morning, opt for the fresh catch eggs Benedict with sliced avocado, grilled tomato and blackened fish topped with poached eggs and Hollandaise. It's almost too big for the plate, but you'll manage. Don't leave without trying their exceptional Key lime pie, served simply with a snappy graham cracker crust, thin layer of dense, perfectly acidic custard and topped with torched meringue.
